notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changelog:

Bugs:

- All beds now have collisions

Improvements:

- Light performance optimizations

- Shadows improvements and optimizations

- The bureau agent will knock on the door every 30 seconds

Gameplay:

- New “Devoted” difficulty for the players looking to escape by the skin of their teeth.

- Move some light switches for a better gameplay (no, it’s not the bathroom one, it stays on the outside for gameplay reasons)
